sam_finance: Heads-up — seeing a spike of declines for BlueCrest around 08:12–08:18 PT. Behavior looks like fragmented authorizations from virtual cards. Repro and logs below.
rachel: Is this the tokenized VCN flow or a merchant VCN?
dev_payments: Tokenized VCN from our Stripe integration (processor: PrismPay). Gateway returns AUTH_WINDOW_EXPIRED on the second auth attempt. Example log snippet:```order_id=ORD-7782 gateway_resp=AUTH_WINDOW_EXPIRED charge_ids=[ch_1, ch_2] sequence=[auth, auth]```.
PaymentsBot: alert: 12 failed charges for customer_id=BC-442 in last 6m — failure rate 4.2% (>3% threshold). :warning:
priya: They hit their quota and features are soft-blocked. CS flagged churn risk.
leo: Can we do a one-off retry for the invoiced amount? I can trigger manual retry if finance approves.
sam_finance: We need to try card reattempt first. If that fails, customer requested wire instructions. Nora already asked for fallback.
dev_payments: I can queue a single manual retry for INV-00932 now. Command I'll run: `/payments retry INV-00932 --method=card --vcn=true --attempt=1 --delay=30s`
marta_ops: There's a pattern where our auth window merge doesn't consider back-to-back partial auths within 2.5s. I have a patch to extend window to 4s (PR #456). Staging tests look green.
leo: Hotfix in prod? Risk?
dev_payments: Low-risk change, touches only auth window tolerance. Recommend hotfix with 5m maintenance window.
sam_finance: Approve hotfix + run manual retry. Finance will prepare wire details in parallel in case retry fails.
nora_cs: @sam_finance Customer prefers we attempt card first but asked for wire template. I'll send them the routing + memo once you confirm.
priya: After successful payment, please lift billing hold and note in account activity.
sam_finance: Will do. I'll post outcome here in ~15m. :thumbsup:
